first_page: Flights: /flights/ (search across providers, route facts, price log, itineraries) and one page per lane site under /flights/ (trip, airports, time, distance, map, co2, routes). All on the device from an OurAirports list (public domain). Will not build: live fares or a fare scrape (no keyless fare source; money stays out), booking, accounts, hotels. Flight status and a live map are a later step through OpenSky: its terms and limits were not verified in this session (the sandbox cannot reach it), so it is not built.
